roadmap_alignment.milestone_line: ## 2026-10-18 owner decision — secondary acquisition research must not halt main P0
roadmap_alignment.priority_rationale: Owner selected P0 integration closeout; remaining review makes the already-built controls eligible for safe merge.
roadmap_alignment.goal_contribution: Complete the review and integration boundary without restarting design.
roadmap_alignment.value_signal: Merged controls available for subsequent real delivery; effectiveness remains unmeasured.

problem: Approved acquisition-priority and isolated research policy remains a draft without package review.
affected_users: Culinary owner and independent source research lanes.
root_cause: Existing governance implementation lacks frozen closeout receipts.
desired_outcome: Reviewed policy ready for required CI and safe PR436 merge.
expected_value: Finish the integration and return capacity to product delivery.

options.pros: Reuses passing CI and existing design.
options.cons: Requires honest review of existing artifacts.
Unrequested rework delays delivery without demonstrated defect.

architecture: Documentation and static starter only; no runtime or database change.
tradeoffs: Keep procedural self-reported review assurance; do not claim authenticated chronology or measured effectiveness.
estimated_cost: Existing account usage and normal CI only; no paid API.

decisions.decision: Review and integrate existing PR436 after required gates.
decisions.rationale: The owner explicitly requests closure without restarting completed work.
decisions.expected_consequences: Prospective gate becomes available only after review, CI and merge.

acceptance_criteria: P0 acquisition remains primary and P2 source research cannot block independent delivery.
Rights, semantic-dedup, protected D1 and lane ownership gates preserved.
Honest frozen same-chat reviews and required CI.
risks: Self-reported receipts do not prove independent mental review.
